reason: I always look for a named lab and a batch report, and this actually has one on the page and behind the QR code, plus bisglycinate with no oxide and a clear dose. At $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee, I'd try one box.
objection: Made in China, and I'd want to open the lab report and check that the batch number and the mg really match before I trust it. Also $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli for the same 30 days.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be generic or didn't match the batch number, or if the price stayed at $29.99 with no launch discount, I'd pass.
